# Blueprint

Make the structure visible. Precise lines, measured spacing, technical clarity.

## Use

Use for process maps, technical training, implementation plans, and structured dashboards.

## Essential traits

- Schematic labels and structure
- Thin high-contrast lines
- Numbered modules

## Typography

System monospace for headings and labels; system sans-serif for body text.

## Layout and surfaces

Consistent grid, aligned edges, numbered sections, explicit relationships. Dark navy surfaces, thin cyan rules, 3px corners, subtle grid outside text blocks.

## Palette

- background: #081e42
- surface: #102c50
- text: #eff8ff
- muted: #b0cce4
- accent: #8fe1ff
- border: #426c93

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Blueprint to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace for headings and labels; system sans-serif for body text. Consistent grid, aligned edges, numbered sections, explicit relationships. Dark navy surfaces, thin cyan rules, 3px corners, subtle grid outside text blocks. Palette: background #081e42, surface #102c50, text #eff8ff, muted #b0cce4, accent #8fe1ff, border #426c93. Essential traits: Schematic labels and structure; Thin high-contrast lines; Numbered modules. Avoid: Dense grids behind body text; All-caps body paragraphs; Decoration that resembles real measurements. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
